stories.title: Oman and Germany discuss ties and maritime security
stories.summary: The Defence Ministry's Secretary-General met a German delegation in Muscat to discuss relations between the two countries. The visitors also toured the Maritime Security Centre and its equipment.

stories.title: Oman's economy grows 5.1% in second quarter
stories.summary: Preliminary data shows real GDP rose 5.1% in Q2 2026 to about RO 9.9 billion. Oil activity led the growth, up 14.7%, while non-oil activity grew only 0.7%.

stories.title: Oman is Guest of Honour at Sharjah Book Fair
stories.summary: Oman takes part in the 45th fair from 4 to 15 November with 28 events, including seminars, poetry evenings, children's workshops and folk shows, plus a national pavilion.

stories.title: Services and agriculture grow, industry slips
stories.summary: Services rose 1.5% and agriculture and fisheries 2.3% in the second quarter, while industrial activity fell 1.5% in the preliminary data.

stories.title: Oman beat Canada in Cricket World Cup League 2
stories.summary: Oman defeated Canada in the Men's Cricket World Cup League 2. Match details are at the source.

stories.title: UAE tournament a big chance for Oman women's ice hockey
stories.summary: Muscat Daily reports the tournament in the UAE is a big opportunity for Oman's women's ice hockey team.

stories.title: Ahmad Al Harthy targets a podium in Portimão
stories.summary: Oman's Ahmad Al Harthy is aiming for a podium finish at Portimão, Muscat Daily reports.

stories.title: Oman's 2026–2030 digital roadmap
stories.summary: The transport and communications ministry unveiled a plan with digital services and regional transformation centers in every governorate. Goals include a government AI platform for decisions and local production of servers and computing hardware.

stories.title: First AI zone in Muscat
stories.summary: The zone is being developed with Egypt's Prime Holding Group to attract startups and tech firms, aiming to make Oman a regional hub for technology and investment.

stories.title: National campaign for early breast cancer detection
stories.summary: The Ministry of Health launched a year-long campaign across governorates for Pink October, with education programs, events and partnerships to correct misconceptions and encourage early checkups.

stories.title: Pink Step festival opens in Nizwa
stories.summary: The three-day festival raising breast cancer awareness is organized by Al Dakhiliyah Governorate and partners, with exhibitions, contests and sports, and closes Saturday with Omani Women's Day celebrations.

stories.title: Oman's embassy joins World Cultures Festival in Türkiye
stories.summary: The embassy in Ankara ran a pavilion promoting Omani heritage, civilisation and tourism, offering visitors halwa, coffee and dates alongside traditional crafts and products.
